svg.text: Engineering blueprint — UIAO Master Project Plan · five parallel workstreams · six named gate decisions
Every HR-listed employee has valid OrgPath
Arc Guest Config · Intune config profiles per division
Every PC Entra Joined or documented exception
Every server Arc-connected or documented exception
Hybrid Join = transition state · drift-engine monitored
SASE ZTNA scaled · no MFA-exempt users
Gate decision points — mechanically evaluated from Gitea canon + drift-engine reports
Rollback triggers (halt phase, revert to prior state):
UIAO_163 drift > threshold for > 24 hrs · CA policy blocks > Y% legitimate sign-ins · Drift engine fails to report · Evidence packet signature invalid · P1 SLA breach per UIAO_167
Gates are never passed on executive signature alone — engine reports green · Canon Steward concurs · PR merges · UIAO_172
